configuration: default RV32IMAF_Zicsr_Zifencei plan with partial M3 L1D/data-AXI read, committed cacheable-store, and exact-head single-beat device slices
known_omissions: single-beat device loads and stores are connected through the LSQ/ROB and AXI ID 6, but DeviceBurstable collection, dirty/replacement state, writeback, L2, atomics, and formal L1I are not implemented
ROB, BDB, predictor, rename-map, free-list, ready-table, and completion control bits are not yet fully inventoried
IQ valid, age, replay, wakeup-CAM, and selector proxies are not yet included
memory ingress buffers, completion buffers, full dual-LSU conflict logic, and the final cache hierarchy control proxies are not yet fully inventoried
